folds.title: Claude's model family
points: Bigger models think deeper, but use more of your allowance.
Meet each one, then see it at work.

folds.title: Haiku
points: Made for short, simple jobs you repeat a lot.
Uses the least of your allowance.

folds.title: Haiku at work

chat.you: Sort these 50 comments into praise, complaints and questions.

chat.claude: Done: 21 praise, 17 complaints and 12 questions, each in its own list.

folds.note: A quick, repeat job. No deep thinking needed.

folds.title: Sonnet
points: The best mix of speed and smarts.
Handles everyday writing, summaries and questions.
Fast enough for easy back-and-forth chat.

folds.title: Sonnet at work

chat.you: Summarise this article in five bullet points.

chat.claude: Here are the five main points, in plain words.

folds.note: Everyday work: quick, clear and good enough first time.

folds.title: Opus
points: Built for long coding and knowledge work.
Keeps track of big tasks over a long session.
Slower than Sonnet, and uses more of your allowance.

chat.you: Read these three reports and turn them into one plan.

chat.claude: I found where the reports agree and where they clash. Here is one plan, with open questions marked.

folds.title: Fable
points: Handles long jobs with many steps.
Uses the most of your allowance, so save it for tough work.

folds.title: Fable at work

chat.you: This big project keeps breaking. Find out why and fix it.

chat.claude: I traced it to two parts that clash, fixed both, and checked the rest still works.

folds.note: Hard and many steps: worth the most capable model.

folds.prompt: Which model fits the job? Tap the basket.

items.text: Sort a pile of messages into groups, fast
items.why: Quick, repetitive jobs suit the lightest model.

items.text: Summarise an article and tidy an email
Turn a long list of receipts into a table of dates and amounts
Work through a big coding task over a long session
Untangle a very hard problem with many steps
items.why: Save the most capable model for the toughest jobs.
